items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: If we could have lived like Jules and Jim...

ctx.x: You said Alfred had another club. You mean Max.

Oh, yes. See, yes, I’m so confused. I always got them confused. I used to call Alfred “Max” and Max “Alfred.” I had no pride. [LAUGHS] I’m sorry. Well, what the hell, they were both wonderful. If I could have had them both together... If we could have lived like Jules and Jim... But...ok... There I was at the Blue Angel every night, meeting glamorous, wonderful people, and looking elegant, and raising two little daughters, and having a wonderful apartment on the Upper East Side. Living it up for the first time in…

So you have your kids, and you have a real shift in your lifestyle. It seems like instead of being a working woman, you were becoming more of a housewife, raising your two daughters, and then you got involved politically.
